room_rent.note: Domestic cover: room rent at actuals with no sub-limit. International cover: Single Private Air-Conditioned Room.

icu.note: Both domestic and international ICU covered at actual expenses.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on core covers. 20% co-pay applies only on optional Dental Plan Benefits (international). Optional deductible on international inpatient.

sub_limits.note: Domestic: AYUSH capped (INR 5L–7.5L by SI band), Living donor INR 5K, Rehabilitation INR 50K, Air Ambulance per schedule. International: Living donor USD 30K, Rehabilitation USD 750, Air Ambulance USD 7,500. Core inpatient up to SI.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional aggregate deductible of USD 0/500/1000 on international inpatient benefits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 35 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 20% per claim-free year on domestic SI; max 100%. Reduced by 20% after a claim year.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined but not listed as a covered benefit.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient covered under domestic plan up to INR 5L–7.5L depending on SI band. Not covered under international plan.

organ_donor.note: Domestic: up to INR 5,000. International: up to USD 30,000.

ambulance.note: Local road ambulance up to SI for both domestic and international. Air ambulance up to USD 7,500 (international, Imperial Plan only).

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, etc. as per Annexure III.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables used during surgery are covered as part of inpatient treatment.

global_cover.note: International inpatient cover is a core part of the plan. Area of cover (with or without USA) specified in policy schedule.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, OPD treatment (domestic), infertility/IVF, cosmetic surgery, dental (except accident inpatient), external congenital anomalies, AYUSH excluded internationally
optional_riders: Dental Plan (international) with 20% co-pay; optional aggregate deductible (USD 500/1000) on international inpatient
